title: Draft daily-loop observable action trace
claim: Mapped existing public review/context/record seams for a short daily loop, with expected result fields, missing product steps, and a fixture-driven adapter draft. No source edits. No human-usability, P044, native, account, or readiness claim.

findings.failure: CLI tell --json returns CorrectResult (claim_ids[], event_id string). MCP correct returns Envelope<CorrectData> (claim_id nullable, event_id nullable, different rewritten/ambiguous fields).
findings.invariant: UX/DX/AX should project one semantic capability; result bytes are not the same object.
findings.correction: P088/P099 must observe each surface separately. Unifying the objects is a named contract change, not this packet.

findings.failure: RFC names kizuki audit --corrections. The shipped verb has no such flag.
findings.invariant: No advertised capability without an implementation (architecture invariant 10).
findings.correction: Treat as unshipped. P006 owns canonical docs.

findings.failure: --about and --page are parsed but cannot satisfy hasExactTarget.
findings.invariant: Fail closed on unnamed correction targets.
findings.correction: Already asserted by packages/cli/test/tell.test.ts:139-148. Do not duplicate.

findings.failure: App exposes query, activity, undo, capture. No context packet. No tell/correct.
findings.invariant: Daily loop is CLI/MCP; app is not a substitute oracle.
findings.correction: Expose as missing. Do not replace P044.

findings.failure: tell --claim discovery via doctor lists at most eight live claims.
findings.invariant: Record targeting must name a live claim.
findings.correction: Document the cap. Expanding the list is out of this packet.
